final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), total AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS denom FROM grouped), ratios AS (SELECT g.healtheval, g.n, 1.0 * g.n / t.denom AS ratio FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN total AS t), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM ratios) SELECT AVG(r.n) AS avg_group_count, AVG(r.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(r.ratio - a.mean_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM ratios AS r CROSS JOIN avg_ratio AS a WHERE r.ratio > a.mean_ratio
